name: bld3_card_conjClasses_of_card_prime_mul_prime
statement: (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p < q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) : Nat.card (ConjClasses G) = p + (q - 1) / p
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (hpq : p < q) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p * q) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a), Nat.card (ConjClasses G) = p + (q - 1) / p
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_center_eq_bot_of_card_prime_mul_prime and Mathlib2.alg_isCyclic_of_card_eq_prime_mul_prime: the centre is trivial, so every non-identity class has size p or q; the normal Sylow q-subgroup contributes (q-1)/p classes of size p (centralizer of order q), the remaining q(p-1) elements of order p have centralizer of order p and form p - 1 classes of size q; total 1 + (q-1)/p + (p-1).
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → p < q → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p * q → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → Nat.card (ConjClasses G) = p + (q - 1) / p
